prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which changes work or prediction accuracy.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -6.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Personality Selector: Rebuild the pick_friend screen into a stage layout with animated choice cards highlighting pet behaviors and temperament traits. (why: Adoption has a low 60.9% conversion rate and high mean time (1017s); interactive choices help users connect faster.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a new screen after waiting that visually explains how to interact, minimize, and talk to your pet on the desktop. (why: Multiple support emails (3 emails) indicate post-onboarding confusion around controlling and hiding desktop pets.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Late Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Move the sign_in step to occur right after pet adoption certificate so users build emotional attachment before account setup. (why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users early; moving it later leverages investment in their newly created pet.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Style Verification Flow: Add a dedicated pet verification screen before adoption certificate so users review and approve custom pet rendering. (why: Support receives 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking unexpected.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Duration and Feature Comparison Hint: Add clear time estimates and path comparison hints to help users choose between quick adoption and custom creation. (why: Choose_path has a high mean time of 514s (8.5 mins), showing decision paralysis during path selection.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Setup Progress and Live Tips Carousel: Display explicit progress percentages and a tip carousel explaining desktop integration while the pet renders. (why: The waiting step has a long mean wait time (2336s) and 3 support complaints mention pets failing to appear.)
6: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop System Tray Control Instructions: Update home_intro text to clearly detail shortcut keys and system tray behavior for calling or hiding the pet. (why: Finish step drops 35.2% of remaining users and support notes confusion on controlling/hiding pets post-setup.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Switch: Enable desktop notification alert toggle on the waiting screen so users get pinged when setup completes. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing users to switch windows and drop off.)

scores.note: Target step loses 39.1% users, but prior redesign test yielded -6.5% lift.
Strong evidence from 3 support emails, but adding a screen increases friction and cost.
Reordering sign-in reduces early friction by leveraging pet creation investment.
Addresses render complaints, but adding another step can lower adoption rate.
Low cost hint addresses high 514s decision time on path selection.
High wait time (2336s mean) and 3 complaints support adding wait-time info.
Finish drops 35.2%; copy fix directly addresses support complaints at low cost.
Notifications bring back users who switch away during long 201s median wait.
